basis: Supplied pre-challenge scientific/reference package (version 20/3/1448) and Participant Guide final judging rubric

requirements.requirement: Qur’an text and approved translations must be traceable to King Fahd Complex / approved translations or Quranpedia.net.
requirements.implementation: All 9 Qur’an records use Quranpedia.net and identify the English translation as Sahih International.

requirements.requirement: Approved Qur'an translations should use the trusted translation platforms identified in the latest scientific package, including QuranEnc for multilingual Qur'an translations.
requirements.implementation: For explicit live Qur'an references, BAYYIN prefers QuranEnc english_saheeh for the English translation while Quranpedia remains the live Qur'an text/reference source; Quranpedia translation is a graceful fallback. Static seed records retain their recorded Quranpedia/Sahih International provenance.

requirements.requirement: Hadith records should use the approved hadith sources and include source plus an approved grading/ruling in the data.
requirements.implementation: All 3 hadith records use Dorar.net records and include grading_ar, grading_en, grading_source_url and grading_basis.

requirements.requirement: Every religious quotation must be traceable to its source and insufficient information must be disclosed.
requirements.implementation: Every source record has source_url, source_platform, provenance and verification_date.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish source text from generated explanation.
requirements.implementation: The UI visually separates primary Arabic source text from approved translation/display rendering; AI output is described as verification/context analysis rather than source evidence.

requirements.requirement: Do not independently issue personal fatwas.
requirements.implementation: Specialist-review safety gate remains automatic; the dedicated “sensitive question” quick-demo card was removed so BAYYIN is not framed as a fatwa/Q&A product.

requirements.requirement: Prefer abstention/caution when evidence is insufficient.
requirements.implementation: insufficient_evidence remains a first-class result; weak candidates are withheld and live-source failures fall back safely.

review_note: Hackathon competition-final build. Qualified scholarly review of the source corpus, contextual notes, and classification rules is still required before public deployment.
